title: 应用文句子升级：只升你能控制的部分
keywords: 应用文句子升级：只升你能控制的部分
brain_first: 按原文查阅 应用文句子升级：只升你能控制的部分

blocks.text: 基础句没有错就不要强行“炫技”。升级优先从连接和具体化开始。

rows:
The activity is useful because students can practise
speaking with real visitors.

The activity gives students a real chance to practise
speaking with visitors.

Not only can the activity... but also... (if you cannot
control the structure).

An advanced structure is not worth a
grammar error.
blocks.text:
Level | Example | Why it is better
Basic | The activity is useful. | Correct but vague.
Clear | The activity is useful because students can practise
speaking with real visitors. | Adds a reason.
Natural | The activity gives students a real chance to practise
speaking with visitors. | More natural verb + specific content.
Do not
force | Not only can the activity... but also... (if you cannot
control the structure). | An advanced structure is not worth a
grammar error.

数。
